offering_description.value: Mines and processes fine-mesh proppant (frac sand) at large Permian Basin mines and delivers it to oil and gas exploration and production companies and oilfield service firms. It also provides last-mile logistics, including trucking, rail-served transload and wellsite storage, to deliver sand to well pads.

primary_services.value: last-mile sand logistics; wellsite sand storage and delivery; trucking and transloading

customer_segment.value: B2B: oil and gas exploration and production operators and pressure pumping service companies in the Permian Basin

end_markets.value: oil and gas exploration and production; oilfield services; hydraulic fracturing

revenue_model.value: product sales: frac sand sold per ton under long-term take-or-pay and spot contracts; service fees: last-mile logistics and delivery of sand to wellsites

value_chain_position.value: raw materials: mines and processes sand from owned reserves, sold to E&P and oilfield service customers; asset operator: operates mines, rail loadout, conveyor system, trucks and wellsite storage equipment

geography_served.value: US regional: Permian Basin in West Texas and southeastern New Mexico

specialization.value: related lines: frac sand production plus last-mile logistics and wellsite storage for the same customers

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: contracts with E&P operators and pressure pumping service companies; other: conveyor, rail and truck delivery directly to wellsites

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: mining safety under MSHA, silica dust exposure under OSHA, and state and federal environmental permitting

notes: Company size is a judgment call; details of the Hi-Crush acquisition and logistics scale-up may be imprecise.
